title: Spiral Mark
summary: The Spiral Mark, located in Siberia, under the Blood Spiral Base, is an ancient magic sigil created by Void as a beacon to call the Nullifiers to Earth. It was sealed by Lord Casterwill and could only be re-activated when stabbed by the Willblade, combined with Void, with Phoenix flying up above, on the longest night of the year whilst the Red Comet was in the sky. The sigil itself became the symbol of the Blood Spiral Brotherhood, with every member being endowed with a tattoo on their body upon joining.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Long before recorded time, Void, a Nullifier scout, found Earth by chance and created the Spiral Mark as a beacon, calling his brethren to Earth to wipe out all life. [Words from Eathon] After 500 years of fighting, before Lord Casterwill defeated the Nullifiers, he sealed the Mark so that could it be used again, sealing it with the Willblade of his elder daughter as it could only be wielded by the true of heart. [The Spiral Mark] After his death, his best friend, later known as the Betrayer, tried to open the Mark again with Void on the longest night of the year. Casterwill's children defeated him, preventing the Nullifiers' return, and from there on the Casterwill family's purpose was to never let it open again.[Chasing Void]

Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill, however, activated the Spiral Mark by mistake, having been led by the Betrayer's faked quatrains of Nostradamus to think that stabbing the heart of the mark with the Willblade would prevent Nullifiers from returning to Earth, though this was planned by the Betrayer himself eons ago.[The Spiral Mark]

Even though Dante Vale destroyed the Red Comet, the Betrayer revealed that he could actually use his own powers to open the Spiral Mark and bring the Nullifiers back.[Lok and the Betrayer] Lok invoked two Legendary Titans, Quetzalcoatl and Pendragon, to defeat Demigorgan. After stabbing the Betrayer through the Spiral symbol on his back, the Betrayer disintegrated. Though the Betrayer was seemingly defeated, the Spiral Mark appeared to still be active and could be seen signalling out to something far across space. [Dante's Return]
